messages:
DeployBot: Heads-up: config-only push for /v1/embeddings (routing + batching + timeouts). Schedule: 2025-06-15 03:30 UTC. Canary plan: 3% for 8m -> 30% for 8m -> 100% roll. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx_rate >= 0.8% OR p95_latency delta >= 150ms for two 5m windows. Deploy ID: cfg-20250615-emb-007.

lucy: small ask 25  is the tenant-floor change opt-in? we had earlier complaints about emb-heavy small tenants.
tor: This change tightens tenant_floor from 0.02 -> 0.04 for embeddings route. It's global but dedicated tenants are excluded via tenant_tag!="dedicated".
emma: can we add a short-circuit that disables batching.timeout shrink for low-QPS tenants? helps avoid latency regressions for infrequent calls.
kevin: good call. Proposal: if tenant_qps < 0.5 rps, keep timeout_ms=60, else set timeout_ms=30. Implemented as routing rule.
opsbot: Note: release doc with diff and dashboards: https://redwood.internal/releases/cfg-20250615-emb-007. Monitoring widgets: emb-p95, emb-5xx, small-tenant-errors.

DeployBot: Diff (config fragment):
```yaml
route: /v1/embeddings
batching:
  max_batch_size: 8
  timeout_ms: 30
routing:
  geo_affinity: zone
  tenant_rules:
    - if: tenant.qps < 0.5
      batching.timeout_ms: 60
qos:
  tenant_floor: 0.04
exclude_tags: [ "dedicated" ]
```

lucy: are we changing any circuit breakers?
tor: no change to circuit breakers. only routing + batching + tenant_floor. CB thresholds stay same.
emma: observability checklist: enable per-tenant p95, small-tenant error rate, and sample traces for slow requests. I'll add APM sampling to 100% for canary.
kevin: adding synthetic probes: 10 s2s requests from three regions at canary start to validate latencies.
opsbot: Runbook snippets in release doc: manual rollback command + how to pin tenant overrides.

lucy: manual rollback CLI?
DeployBot: Manual rollback: `redwoodctl config rollback --id cfg-20250608-emb-005 --env prod` (also documented).

opsbot: T-10m watch volunteers? tor on-call for infra, emma for observability, kevin for synths. lucy will handle comms.
tor: I'll tail inference logs and watch GC pressure on pools.
emma: on-call dashboard link: /dashboards/embeddings/canary. I'll post snapshots to #release-watch at each phase.

DeployBot: Canary started at 03:30 UTC -> 3% traffic. First check-in at 03:38.
emma: initial p95 looks normal (delta +12ms), 5xx 0.03%. starting APM traces and probe results.
kevin: synths report p95 region-eu +45ms, region-us +10ms. region-eu might be noise due to warmup.
lucy: keep an eye on small-tenant-errors metric. if >1% for any tenant with qps<1, we cut canary to 0% and investigate.

DeployBot: Moving to 30% at 03:38 UTC.
tor: infra: no pool evictions. memory stable.
emma: APM shows an uptick in a specific backend host in eu-west-1; sampling traces point to higher KV cache miss on that host.
kevin: starting a targeted warmup for that host (prefill KV cache for popular prefixes). will report in 5m.

opsbot: Alert rule triggered: small-tenant-errors for tenant "alpha-proto" = 1.6% at 03:44 UTC. Auto-unwind condition? lucy?
lucy: alpha-proto is a sandbox tenant on shared pool; roll back the routing.timeout_ms change for tenants with qps<0.5. Apply override and keep rollout at 30%.
DeployBot: Applying override: tenant_override(alpha-proto): batching.timeout_ms=60. Change applied.
emma: post-override alpha-proto errors -> 0.2% after 2m. good.
kevin: warmup helped eu-west host; p95 back to baseline.

DeployBot: Canary continuing; will proceed to 100% at 03:46 if stable.
tor: recommended: proceed but keep a 15m extended watch due to regional variance.
lucy: agreed. extended watch until 04:05. I'll notify support to be ready for inbound.

DeployBot: Roll to 100% at 03:46 UTC. Post-roll health (03:55 snapshot): emb-5xx 0.05%, emb-p95 delta +18ms, small-tenant-errors 0.12% overall. No further action.

kevin: follow-up: we'll schedule a follow-up config to add a more explicit per-tenant warmup policy (prefill KV for high-prefix reuse) to avoid future small-tenant blips.
emma: I'll capture the traces and attach to the release doc.

DeployBot: Closing thread scheduled at 04:05 UTC if no regressions. Thanks all.
